interface.signature: def omit_hashtag(message: str, hashtag: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: The `hashtag` must start with a '#' character (e.g., '#lta').
The `hashtag` must begin with the '#' character.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '#' for c in hashtag)
preconditions.description: The `hashtag` must consist only of alphanumeric characters and a leading '#'.

postconditions.description: If `hashtag` does not appear in `message`, return the original `message` unchanged.

postconditions.expression: hashtag in message and return_value == message.replace(hashtag, '', 1)
postconditions.description: If `hashtag` appears in `message`, remove only the first occurrence of `hashtag` from `message`.

postconditions.expression: return_value == message.replace(hashtag, ' ', 1) if hashtag in message else message
postconditions.description: When removing the first occurrence of `hashtag`, replace it with a single space (preserving surrounding spaces).
